author: Sir Fuffle
title: No longer fun after greedy update
content:
Is this game a huge case of false advertisement? Yes. The screenshots are not the game at all. 

Is the actual game still fun?
Yes. You can buy the $1 gold pack to remove forced ads and then the gameplay is addictive and rewarding and there’s always something to work towards even without paying anymore

My only problem is the latest “beta” update when they added the Arena. They made it more colorful and added a dedicated UI to hide the fact that they have SEVERELY nerfed the rate that you can get gold. 

Counters used to be the BEST way to win gold at high tiers because you start with a 3x multiplier. If you stack that with a 2x win streak multiplier and a 3-4x rewarded ad multiplier, you can get 1-2 million gold on a good counter. This is balanced because at high tiers, card upgrades all cost 1+ million. I used to be able to get 75k-150k gold (base rate) from a good counter, and the attempts were only limited by how many people attacked me (not limited to 5 tickets per day like now).

Now, my base gold from a good counter is more like 3k. That’s 50x less gold than I was making on the old system!

To be fair, the ticket system would be fine if they didn’t mess with the gold cap. I’m not paying you people anymore money. I’ll just quit if the game economy fails me.

So it’s up to you devs: revert the gold cap back to normal (and keep letting us get packs from counters and revenge), or lose a player that watches several rewarded ads per day and puts hours on your game.
